answer: Here is a specific defense: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the shale to sunk effort, uses the vine as an corroborating signal, then requires a summit before any payout.
